title: Item stand
content:
# Item stand

Type: Furniture | Source: Workbench | Crafting Materials: Finewood x4, Bronze nails x1 | Support: Wood (from 10 to 100) | Loss: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

Item stands are decorative structures that can be used to display trophies or other resources a player may have collected. They come in two variants, vertical and horizontal.

## Usage

Items that can be put on an item stand:
• All Food except Honey (horizontal only)
• All Bombs (also Basalt bomb)
• Asksvin egg
• Barber kit
• Barrel hoops
• Bell
• Black core
• Dragon egg
• Dragon tear
• Dverger circlet
• Egg
• Fish
• Fuling totem
• Hildir's hats
• Hildir's chests (horizontal only)
• Meads (horizontal only)
• Midsummer crown
• Saddles
• Scythe
• Scythe handle
• Sealbreaker
• Shields
• Swamp key
• Tools
• Torn spirit
• Trophies
• Weapons excluding Arrows and Bolts
• Yule hat
Items that cannot be put on an item stand:
• Valuables
• Arrows
• Bolts
• Armor (excluding the ones above)
• Crystal
• Dandelion
• Accessories
• Feathers
• Guck
• Hide
• Honey
• Mead bases
• Metals
• Nails
• Neck tail
• Ores
• Pelts
• Raw meats
• Resin
• Seeds (excluding Jotun puffs and Magecap)
• Surtling core
• Thunder stone
• Thistle
• Torch
• Withered bone
• Wood
• Majestic carapace
(This list is incomplete and will be updated as we go)

## Notes

• Rotating the vertical item stand will flip horizontally but not vertically; so "crossed swords" are not possible at this time.

Categorias: Furniture, Storage
